name: Form Error Summary
description: A top-of-form alert that lists validation errors as anchor links which focus the offending field.
usage:
<FormErrorSummary
  errors={[
    { fieldId: "email", label: "Email", message: "Enter a valid email address." },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: A role=alert region, so new validation failures are announced as soon as it renders.
A customizable title summarizing the failure count or context.
Anchor links, one per error, whose targets are the offending field ids.
A decorative alert icon; the message text carries the meaning.

dos: Place it at the top of the form and move focus there after a failed submit.
Keep each link's message identical to the error shown at its field.
Pass real field ids so activating a link focuses the control.
donts: Don't render it for a single inline error; the field message is enough.
Don't link to fields that are hidden or disabled on the current step.

examples.title: Multiple field errors
examples.description: Each error becomes a link whose target is the field id, so activating it moves focus straight to the control.

examples.title: Single error with custom title
examples.description: The heading can be tailored to the error count or form context while the linking behavior stays the same.

guidance.useWhen: Long or complex forms submit server- or client-side validation failures that users must locate quickly.
guidance.avoidWhen: A single visible field fails inline; the Field error message alone is enough and a summary would repeat it.
guidance.behavior: Activating an error link prevents navigation and focuses the element with the matching id, adding tabindex=-1 first when it is not naturally focusable. Renders nothing when the errors list is empty.
guidance.responsive: The summary stacks its icon, heading, and link list at any width within the form container.

notes: The summary uses role="alert" so new validation failures are announced as soon as it renders.
Each entry is a real anchor linking to the field id, so the destination is exposed to assistive technology even before activation.

props.description: Field errors listed as focus links; the summary renders nothing when empty.
props.name: errors

props.description: Called after an error link is activated, with its item.
props.name: onErrorClick
